description: This file defines the enum 'OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction' along with nested structs and static methods related to UI actions in an OpenClaw canvas context. It provides utility functions for extracting and sanitizing action data, formatting messages, and dispatching UI action statuses.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: An enum encapsulating UI action utilities and nested data structures related to agent messaging and action formatting.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext
classes.description: Represents the context for an agent message, including session and component information, with properties and an initializer.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext.Session
classes.description: Holds session-specific data such as key and surfaceId.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction.AgentMessageContext.Component
classes.description: Contains component details like id, host, and instanceId.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a user action dictionary by checking specific keys.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes a string value by trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and replacing disallowed characters with underscores.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Converts a JSON object to a compact string if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats an agent message string based on the provided context.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript snippet to dispatch UI action status to the window event system.
